def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    counts=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x)
    for c,n in counts.items():
        if n<2: continue
        cells=[(r,col) for r in range(len(g)) for col in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][col]==c]
        if len(cells)==2 and cells[0][1]==cells[1][1]:
            moving=max(cells); dr,dc=-1,0
        else:
            moving=max(cells,key=lambda p:p[1]); dr,dc=0,-1
        r,col=moving; g[r][col]=0
        while 0<=r+dr<len(g) and 0<=col+dc<len(g[0]) and g[r+dr][col+dc]==0:
            r+=dr; col+=dc
        g[r][col]=c
    return g
